title: 1985 AHSME Problem 16
statement: If \(A=20^\circ\) and \(B=25^\circ,\) then the value of \((1+\tan A)(1+\tan B)\) is

solutions.text: Because \(\tan(A+B)=\tan45^\circ=1,\) \[ \frac{\tan A+\tan B}{1-\tan A\tan B}=1, \] so \(\tan A+\tan B\) \(=1-\tan A\tan B.\) Therefore \[ \begin{aligned} &(1+\tan A)(1+\tan B)\\ &\quad=1+(1-\tan A\tan B)\\ &\qquad+\tan A\tan B\\ &\quad=2. \end{aligned} \] Thus the correct answer is B.
hints: Use \(A+B=45^\circ\) in the tangent addition formula
Express \(\tan A+\tan B\) in terms of \(\tan A\tan B\)
